name: Stage HUD
author: MatchFrame
licence: MIT; weapon icons third-party MIT (third-party-licenses/); fonts: SIL OFL 1.1
description: Tournament-stage broadcast HUD: series strip and minimap top left, event line and score bar with players alive top centre, sponsor slot and killfeed top right, five side-coloured player cards in each bottom corner with the round MVP's card and the observed player's cam between them, and a full-width scoreboard with economy, loss bonus, timeouts and coaches in freeze time.

ctColor.label: CT colour
ctColor.description: Colour of the team on CT, unless the team has its own colour.

tColor.label: T colour
tColor.description: Colour of the team on T, unless the team has its own colour.

eventTitle.label: Event line, left
eventTitle.description: Shown at the left of the line over the score bar; the event's name when empty.

stageTitle.label: Event line, right
stageTitle.description: Shown at the right of the line over the score bar; the match's stage and title when empty.

showSeries.label: Series strip
showSeries.description: The series maps over the minimap.

killfeedRows.label: Killfeed rows
killfeedRows.description: Most kills shown at once; each stays about seven seconds.

showSponsors.label: Sponsor slots
showSponsors.description: The top bar sponsor at the top right and the scoreboard sponsor in freeze time (from Sponsors; nothing shows when none is scheduled).

showObserved.label: Observed player
showObserved.description: The observed player's cam (when player cams are on air), stats and name bar between the teams.

showScoreboard.label: Freeze-time scoreboard
showScoreboard.description: The full-width scoreboard in freeze time and timeouts; off keeps the player cards.

showMvp.label: Round MVP card
showMvp.description: The last round's key player in a tall card in their team's list: at the round's end and the first seconds of the next round.
